_note: Corrections for rows the Taiwan sheet records awkwardly, keyed by its product id. `id` replaces a placeholder product code, `nameEn` supplies a title, and `blade` says which blade the row really is so it shares that blade's tournament record instead of looking untested. `assist` / `overblade` backfill an in-the-box part the sheet leaves off: `assist` fills a blank assist column, `overblade` supplies the CX Expand Blade over blade (single-letter code, defined in manualParts.json) the sheet has no column for at all.
_over_blades: Only the four confirmed CX Expand Blade families ship an over blade (Bahamut Blitz→Break B, Ragna Rage→Flow F, Unicorn Delta→Peak P, Brachio Whip→Outer O); every other CX blade uses the original three-part Main Blade system and gets none. The blank assist columns on the CX random-booster rows (e.g. CX-05-04, CX-08-04, CX-11-02, CX-17-03) are deliberately left blank: those are UX/BX blades, which have no assist blade — filling them would be wrong.
